title: Peanut Allergy Diagnoses Fell 43% After Advice Reversed
hook: Peanut allergy diagnoses fell 43% after the advice flipped.
closing: Early guidance can reshape a child's lifelong allergy risk.
question: Did your family's peanut advice change?

segments.say: Peanut allergy reached 1.4 percent in 2008, more than tripling from the earliest measurement.
Avoidance produced a 13.7 percent allergy rate, while early consumption was far lower.
Peanut allergy diagnoses fell about 43 percent after guidance changed, though comparison alone cannot prove cause.
